title: Cash on hand
subtitle: Cash each collector is holding until it is deposited and verified.
positionsHint: Over-limit first. The limit is set per collector. Click a row to see which collections the cash came from.
depositsHint: Verify only after you have counted the cash or seen the bank slip.
verifyDesc: Confirm that you received exactly this amount. The collector's cash on hand goes down by {{amount}}. This is recorded in the audit log.
rejectDesc: The money stays on the collector's cash on hand. Tell them what is wrong so they can deposit again.
deleteDesc: The deposit stays in the history as deleted. The money goes back to the collector's cash on hand, and they are told. This is recorded in the audit log.
emptyPendingBody: New deposits from collectors will appear here.

inHand.title: Cash on hand of {{name}}
inHand.subtitle: The cash collections not yet covered by a deposit
inHand.list: Collections behind the cash on hand
inHand.more: {{n}} older collections are not listed; the total above includes them.
inHand.how: Deposits pay off the oldest collections first, so the cash on hand is the newest collections. Field-system cash, not an ERP balance.

depositDetail.title: {{name}}'s deposit
depositDetail.subtitle: The cash collections this deposit covered
depositDetail.unmatchedNote: deposit money with no collection behind it
depositDetail.rejectedEmpty: A rejected or deleted deposit covers nothing; the cash is back on hand.
depositDetail.how: A deposit pays off the oldest collections first, so this list and the cash on hand never overlap. Field-system cash, not an ERP balance.
